question: Which family group can be an exact symmetry of the common source process at the moment the Gate-B interaction acts?
verdict_scope: Conditional on Theta_1 keeping its Delta N = +-4 (U(1) -> Z4) vertex for three light families; family groups acting linearly on the light families; source layers as declared (seam SU(4), matter selection, v117 transport).
mathematical_verdict: CENTRE_CRITERION_G_CAP_SCALARS_IN_MU4; INVARIANTS_3x4: U3 0, SU3 0, SO3 3, A4 7, B3 4, Z4^3xS3 1; MATTER_SELECTION_STABILISER_U3; TRANSPORT_CENTRALISER_U1_REAL_TYPE_A4_MONOMIAL_BASIS; DECK_INTERTWINER_REAL_UP_TO_PHASE
